visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with styled dark hair and a black t-shirt is centered in the frame against a plain white studio background. He speaks with expressive facial movements and gestures with his hands to engage the viewer. He then holds a sleek black cosmetic bottle labeled KATE while smiling at the camera. (2) A close-up shot of a hand shows the beige liquid foundation being dispensed onto the skin. The man's fingers spread the creamy texture across his hand, demonstrating its fluidity and coverage level. He then holds a small white wedge-shaped makeup sponge up for inspection. (3) The man applies the foundation to his face using a three-layer technique. The frame often splits or uses white dotted line overlays to show a comparison effect on different halves of his face. He uses a dabbing motion with the white sponge to blend the product into his skin. (4) He demonstrates highlighting and contouring using a third layer of foundation specifically on the T-zone and nose. He concludes by using a black powder compact and a black brow pencil. The final shot features him posing with the products, showing off a clear skin finish.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-pitched, energetic male vocal with clear articulation and rapid speech rate opens the video. It is accompanied by a driving electronic BGM with a steady beat featuring synthetic bass and percussion. The recording environment is a silent studio with no ambient noise. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect with high spectral brightness occurs at the 10-second mark, synced with a visual logo. The vocal maintains high arousal and instructional tone while the background music persists at a consistent intensity level. (3) Low-frequency percussive 'impact' sound effects are heard intermittently, simulating the sound of a makeup sponge hitting skin. A shimmery 'whoosh' transition SFX occurs during scene cuts and split-screen comparisons. The narrator's tone is consistently upbeat and professional. (4) Additional digital 'sparkle' sound effects punctuate the highlighting demonstration phase. The musical intensity remains high until the final second, where the narrator increases vocal projection for a high-arousal closing statement as the BGM tracks stop abruptly.
